title: Player stats
one_line: The full career numbers, reachable behind the profile's STATS tab or as its own drill-down.
opens_from: profile (STATS tab, if it needs a drill-down beyond the 3x3)

anatomy.spec: Wells grouped by category (Matches, Combat, Progression) rather than one flat grid - this is where the full detail lives that Profile's 3x3 summary does not have room for.

data: StatsService, same source as Profile's summary - this is the detail view, not a second data source.
do_not: Do not duplicate the 3x3 summary - this is the expanded detail view, reached only if the owner wants a drill-down beyond Profile's nine stats.
acceptance: Every number matches the summary on Profile.
Grouped, labelled, all text 12 pt or larger.
steps: 1. Preflight - confirm with the owner whether this drill-down is still wanted now that Profile's STATS tab exists, or whether it should be folded into Profile entirely.
2. Rebuild with grouped section labels and wells.
